article.title: 更進新聞：Teads把Adelaide注意力指標接入Ad Manager
article.title_en: Follow-up: Teads embeds Adelaide attention metrics in Ad Manager
article.summary: Teads於11月3日公布新整合，讓廣告主在平台內查看AU報告並設定注意力門檻。
article.summary_en: Teads’ November 3 integration adds native AU reporting and attention thresholds in its ad platform.
highlights: 報告涵蓋網頁及CTV InStream，可按格式、裝置與版位查看。
Attention Threshold可設定AU下限，過濾低於門檻的庫存。
highlights_en: Reporting covers web and CTV InStream, with format, device and placement breakdowns.
Attention Threshold can apply an AU floor to filter inventory.
article.why: 媒體團隊可把注意力品質訊號與CTR等指標一同查看，再決定如何調整版位。
article.why_en: Media teams can compare attention-quality signals with delivery metrics before adjusting placements.
article.next_step: 先了解AU模型及門檻影響，再以小範圍比較觸及、成本與轉換。
article.next_step_en: Review the AU model and threshold effects, then compare reach, cost and conversions on a limited test.
article.detail: AU是Adelaide預測版位吸引注意力及帶來結果可能性的指標，不能直接當成每名觀眾真正觀看的時間。Teads表示量度在Ad Manager全球提供，可與可視率、影片觀看及點擊率並列。這次是在既有Ad Manager上的量度與優化擴展，並非重新發布整個平台。門檻會影響可買庫存，較高AU亦不等於已證實較高銷售；實際效果需按活動核對。
article.detail_en: AU predicts placement-level attention and outcome potential; it is not each viewer’s measured viewing time. Teads says measurement is globally available in TAM alongside viewability, views and CTR. Higher AU does not establish higher sales, and thresholds can affect available supply.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
article.followup: 延續10月31日本報介紹Ad Manager更新；11月3日新增Adelaide原生AU報告及門檻優化。
article.followup_en: Following our October 31 Ad Manager coverage, the November 3 announcement adds native Adelaide AU reporting and threshold optimization.
